data.title: Create a MariaDB database and user
data.summary: CREATE DATABASE, CREATE USER, then GRANT — in that order.
data.body:
Database

CREATE DATABASE note_mgmnt
  CHARACTER SET utf8mb4
  COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

User and grants

CREATE USER 'app'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'change-me';
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON note_mgmnt.* TO 'app'@'%';
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;

Use 'app'@'localhost' instead of % when the app runs on the database host.

data.title: Reset a forgotten MariaDB root password
data.body:
1. Stop the server and start it with --skip-grant-tables --skip-networking.

  2. Connect with mariadb -u root and run:

FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'new-password';

  1. Restart normally.

data.title: psql cheat sheet
data.body:
• \l — list databases

  • \c dbname — connect

  • \dt — list tables

  • \d+ table — describe a table

  • \x — toggle expanded output

data.title: Prune unused Docker images and volumes
data.body:
docker system df
docker image prune -a
docker volume prune

Careful: volume prune deletes data in every volume no container is using.

data.title: Reverse proxy to a Node app
data.summary: proxy_pass with the headers Express needs behind a proxy.
data.body:
location /api/ {
  proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3002;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
  client_max_body_size 200m;
}

Raise client_max_body_size or uploads fail with 413.
